description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: review PR6 diff and plan evidence against its actual restacked parent; no planned production changes in this review issue. Verify source ownership, reuse of PR4/PR5 execution and excluded PR7 consumers, contracts/security/lifetimes, Action reuse, native execution traces, test behavior approval evidence and documentation parity. Reproduce correctness findings through focused real-boundary tests; track remediation before closing. Do not post reviews or publish a PR without user authorization.
Tests to add before implementation: review uses existing tests and adds a focused regression only when proving an uncovered defect, following normal approval boundaries. Require fresh targeted validation evidence from affected tasks. Inspect alias scope leakage, forged/nested-principal signature reuse, atomic selection failure, concurrent completion ordering, replays, terminal cleanup and provider acquisition count. No numerical coverage target or premature coverage run.
Branches/paths validated: complete PR6 acceptance matrix, source reference adaptations, error/cancel/timeout/refusal/handoff and next request, no raw handle/content exposure; no duplicate Action or send path. Compare base-versus-branch behavior to distinguish inherited issues.
Mocking plan: real internal ownership/execution paths; use edge stubs for reproducible provider/LLM failures. Findings must cite concrete execution evidence, not speculative abstractions.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: review verdict, findings, scope and fixes in Beadwork; update owning docs through remediation if needed. Final human approval is distinct from technical review.
Action reuse assessment: review-only, no new executable operation; audit ActionContract/Jido validated calls, GetDocument authorization, Provenance projection, OpaqueAliases traversal, StreamEvents state owner, canonical builder and PR5 route. Require successful technical review before handing off to coverage-upper.

Review all four destinations, the widget package contract/release pins, HTTP session authentication, current source authorization, canonical attachment binding and browser acceptance. Approved web execution extensions are in scope; duplication of PR5 mechanisms is not.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
title: [zaq-pi3.9] Complete PR6 technical review
